{{Quote|A Twi'lek dancer named Kalar'naa. She's the common link to several information leaks that have troubled us recently. She leaves town to meet her contact every few days. Will you see to it that she doesn't do that again?|Skinkner|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Kalar'naa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Entertainer|dancer]] and agent for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Skinkner]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with eliminating Kalar'naa due to being suspected for leaking information.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CommonerTwilekFemaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Kalar'naa]]
Kalar'naa was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].

Kalar'naa's appearance was randomized during each quest, but she always appeared as a female Twi'lek. The quest dialogue also confirmed her species and gender.
